This codebook documents the coding scheme for the content analysis of the user comments. Two research assistants used it to manually code a sample of 150 comments (see [Manual Coding & ICR](03_coding_manual_icr.qmd)). The same rules were then translated into the system prompt of the language model that classified all remaining comments (see [System Prompt](appendix_system_prompt.qmd)). You can also [download the codebook as PDF](codebook/codebook.pdf).
